## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run, environment and results. Include reproduction or UI steps where useful. Mark unrun checks and explain why. For model changes, link a public-safe summary of real-model and source-content review.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe migration, rollback or remaining limitations, or write N/A.

## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met and relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect the change.
- [ ] No secrets, private sources, databases, weights or internal work logs are included.
- [ ] Source attribution and existing API behavior are preserved.
- [ ] The full diff is ready for review.
